title: SDK & HTTP API rollout for function-calling, structured output, and streaming — docs, sample library, and coordinated release notes
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Scope: coordinate a unified launch for SDKs and the HTTP API surface supporting function-calling, structured output, and streaming. Deliverables: (1) API reference + migration guide, (2) canonical sample library (Node/Python/Go) demonstrating function-calls + streaming + structured outputs, (3) consolidated release notes and deprecation notices, (4) rollout runbook for staged beta -> GA with monitoring and rollback steps. Acceptance criteria: docs published to docs.redwood.ai, samples published to github.com/redwood-inference/samples with CI passing, release notes prepared and approved by comms, SDK packages published to npm/pypi with compatibility matrix, and telemetry dashboards in Console showing error/latency baselines for the new endpoints.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (internal preview): 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-07 — invite internal apps and Platform SRE testing. Phase 1 (partner beta): 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-17 — limited external customers + partner integration support. Phase 2 (public GA): 2026-03-22 — docs + samples public; SDK releases and release notes published. Rollback policy: default to previous v1 non-structured endpoint; automated rollback via routing policy if error rate > 3% for 15m.
qa_checklist: End-to-end sanity: function-call roundtrip on Node + Python
Streaming chunk order and reconnects validation
SDK integration smoke tests on latest runtime-1.18 images
Backward compatibility tests against legacy endpoints
monitoring_playbook: Dashboards: Console -> SDK Launch -> /api/function (latency/error/cost). Alerts: >=2% 5xx in 10m; token inflation delta >15% vs baseline; streaming disconnect rate >1% per minute. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/SDK+Launch+Runbook
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: SDK samples expose beta API patterns — Mitigation: mark samples with deprecation flags and provide migration snippet
Risk: structured-output regressions cause downstream parsing failures — Mitigation: ship schema validations and a compatibility mode flag
Risk: higher per-token cost for some paths — Mitigation: include Optimize recommendations and suggested quantization profiles in docs
